Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Farmhouse Decorative Candle Holder Lantern with Cutouts - Set of 2, Cream and Blue
These 2 stoneware containers boast a unique cut-out pattern that makes them ideal for mood lighting and holding dry flowers. They come in cream and blue with an elegant trim and a handle for easy transport. 9.5" Diameter x 12"H; 7" Diameter x 9.75"H Stoneware Decorative container This item wipes clean with a soft, dry cloth.
